download_streaming_urls: normalize URLs for streaming data from remote files without actually downloading them
extract_archive_streaming: add extraction protocol to URLs for streaming from compressed archives like zip files
download_and_extract_streaming: combine download and extract in one step to prepare URLs for streaming data
iter_archive_files: iterate over files within a tar or zip archive yielding file paths and binary objects
iter_files_from_paths: iterate over file URL paths from a root directory or list of paths
